subject.title: fix(cli): reject unknown models in config set

question: Should `openclaw config set` intentionally reject changed unresolved text-model references before writing configuration, replacing the previous deferred runtime failure behavior?
rationale: The branch is technically focused and its prior review cycles found no remaining mechanical defect, but whether existing automation may rely on storing unresolved or temporarily unavailable references is a compatibility and operator-policy choice.

options.title: Accept fail-closed validation
options.body: Approve immediate runtime-aligned rejection of changed unresolved text-model references so users receive an actionable CLI error before configuration is persisted.

options.title: Preserve deferred acceptance
options.body: Keep accepting unresolved references and pursue a non-blocking warning or an explicitly opted-in strict validation design instead.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed validation
recommendation.body: Approve immediate runtime-aligned rejection of changed unresolved text-model references so users receive an actionable CLI error before configuration is persisted.

likelyOwner.reason: The visible member review outcome identifies this exact compatibility decision as the remaining human gate.
